'''Hammer Squadron''' was a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that fought in the [[Battle of Lanteeb]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Hammer Squadron took many hits and casualties and the [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilots]] died.

==History==
In 21 BBY, Hammer Squadron was sent to fight [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. This squadron was sent in the cruiser ''[[Pioneer]]''. They fought under the command of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. They took some casualties and lost at least three fighters.
